shortBulletSummary: Crypto market drops as rising yields, oil prices spark risk-off.
Over $700M in crypto long liquidations fueled market sell-off.
Ethereum ETFs face $200M+ outflows; ETH down 6% in 24 hours.

Robinhood buys $25M in Bitcoin for its corporate balance sheet.
